# Canby Community Clinic

> Nonprofit primary care in Reseda, formerly Pura Vida Community Clinic. Weekdays 9–5. Call (818) 674-4414. 7601 Canby Ave #6B, Reseda, CA 91335.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.puravidacc.org/): primary care, how to book, and the clinic address
- [Services](https://www.puravidacc.org/services): checkups, screenings, labs, medicines, and care navigation
- [Appointments](https://www.puravidacc.org/appointments): request a weekday visit
- [Insurance](https://www.puravidacc.org/insurance): what to ask before you come
- [New patients](https://www.puravidacc.org/new-patients): what a first visit is like
- [Care team](https://www.puravidacc.org/care-team): the roles that run the clinic
- [Articles](https://www.puravidacc.org/articles): health guides for Reseda and the west Valley
- [Location](https://www.puravidacc.org/location): map, hours, and parking
- [Contact](https://www.puravidacc.org/contact): phone and office email
- [Donate](https://www.puravidacc.org/give): 501(c)(3) gifts
- [Privacy](https://www.puravidacc.org/privacy): website privacy notice
- [Terms](https://www.puravidacc.org/terms): website terms
